about: Text that one program of the repository looks for in the output of another (entry W3.1-bis.2, item 6). Each entry names the consumer file and the SHA-1 (12 hex digits) of the literal it searches with, and the producer files that must print it: node Controlli/lingua/consumed-strings.js checks every entry, --find prints the texts and the candidates not listed yet, --rebind moves an entry to the literal on a line after a translation. Producer and consumer are translated in the same commit. The literals are not copied here: they are Italian today, and this file may not carry Italian. Left out on purpose: the contract assertions of Prove.Contratti that turn red by themselves when the text they look for disappears (they are their own net and run in seconds), searches on text written by SOLIDWORKS, git, MSBuild or the PDF format, readers of TODO.md, and command-line options.
